comparison.objective: Feed a laminating pouch sealed-edge first and square into a laminator, then release it to the rollers.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and feed a thin sheet precisely with correct release timing at a powered nip.
comparison.success_condition: A square sealed-edge bite exits successfully; open-edge feeding or continued gripping after draw causes a latched jam.
comparison.reason: Thin-sheet orientation and roller handoff do not test mechanical calibration, locking, or post-lock functional cycles.
